name: x
meaning: U origin in texels of a texture rectangle: Bs_TexelToUV's origin argument for every U coordinate (BsDecode_Stride24_Pass1 0x41d1e7)

name: w
meaning: U size in texels: Bs_TexelToUV's size argument for U (0x41d1ee; Bs_TexelToUV reads it with movsx 0x41fc54)

name: page
meaning: texture page, zero-extended into the polygon's texIndex (movzx 0x41d2ec)
